Callout.Name: Disorder on the Beach
Callout.Message: Large group drinking and fighting on the beach.
Callout.Advisory: Around ten people, no weapons seen, families complaining.

Script.Line: It is a beach. People are allowed a drink on a beach.
Nobody is fighting. Nobody is even shouting.
You want us gone, we are gone. Just leave my mates alone.

Lines.Approach: Ten of them, drinking, and families are packing up to leave. Break it up.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
